name: Olive Stardust
card_en: Radiant yet grounded, modern yet timeless echoing the poetic craftsmanship of LEVORCHY
desc_en: crystal embroidery that shimmers like starlight. The strapless silhouette glides with sculpted precision, blending strength and softness in perfect harmony
desc_ar: تطريز كريستالي يتلألأ كضوء النجوم، بقصّة بلا أكتاف تنساب بدقّة منحوتة، تجمع القوة والنعومة في تناغم واحد.

name: Heart of the Aurora
card_en: layers of hand-beaded crimson, silver, and maroon, it shimmers with the rhythm of dawn meeting dusk
desc_en:
Commanding the runway as the centerpiece of the Aurora Bordeaux collection, “The Heart of the Aurora” captures the essence of Levorchy’s universe bold, regal, and luminous. The gown unfolds in deep maroon, scarlet, and crystal gradients, echoing the sky’s transformation from dusk to dawn.

Its sculpted bodice, crafted in maroon and tied into a structured bow, radiates sensual strength, while the voluminous skirt cascades into layers of hand-embroidered sequins and crystal beading that shimmer like celestial waves.  Representing blooming energy at the core of the aurora’s light.
desc_ar: قلب مجموعة أورورا بوردو: طبقات مطرّزة يدوياً بالخرز بألوان القرمزي والفضي والعنابي، تتلألأ كلحظة لقاء الفجر بالغسق.

name: Lemon Mist
card_en: Bathed in the softest hue of pale lemon, Lemon Mist embodies quiet luminosity
desc_en: wrapped in delicate horizontal straps that gracefully cover the upper area, sculpting the silhouette with refined precision. Flowing into a clean, elongated line, the gown embodies Levorchy’s serene sophistication beneath the golden lights of Panorama Dead Sea
desc_ar: بأخفّ درجات الليموني الشاحب، أشرطة أفقية رقيقة تنحت القوام وتنساب في خط طويل نظيف، بهدوء أنيق تحت أضواء بانوراما البحر الميت.

name: Olive Mirage
card_en: sculptural expression of strength and serenity
desc_en: glistens in liquid fabric, draped in a sculptural asymmetry that embraces the body like a whisper of motion. The one shoulder silhouette, gathered in precise folds, reflects the richness of Levorchy’s craftsmanship
desc_ar: قماش سائل لامع بقصّة غير متماثلة على كتف واحد، بطيّات دقيقة تعكس غنى حرفية ليفورشي.

name: Teal Horizon
card_en: thousands of hand-embroidered crystals cascading over sheer tulle
desc_en: mirrors the fleeting hues of dawn where turquoise meets soft aurora light. The gown’s geometric crystals and cascading strands echo the rhythm of the sea at sunrise a masterpiece of movement and luminosity, defining Levorchy’s dialogue between nature and couture.
desc_ar: آلاف من الكريستالات المطرّزة يدوياً تنساب فوق التول الشفاف، كألوان الفجر حين يلتقي الفيروزي بضوء الشفق.

name: Reverie
card_en: An ode to architectural grace and disciplined femininity
desc_en: structured strapless bodice with textural linear detailing that flows seamlessly into a sculpted, pleated lower silhouette, evoking the precision of contemporary art forms
desc_ar: قصّة بلا أكتاف بخطوط منحوتة تنساب إلى تنّورة مطويّة، تحية للأناقة المعمارية والأنوثة المنضبطة.

name: Rose Whispers
card_en: Ethereal femininity while delicate embellishments shimmer like morning dew on petals
desc_en: The gown’s halter neckline and sculpted cutouts blend with glistening embellishments that trace the waistline like constellations, while flowing chiffon sleeves and a cascading hem evoke soft, dreamlike movement
desc_ar: رقبة رسن وفتحات منحوتة وتطريز لامع يرسم الخصر كالنجوم، مع أكمام شيفون منسابة، أنوثة حالمة كندى الصباح على البتلات.

name: Solar Bloom
card_en: Bathed in the soft glow of dawn, Solar Bloom embodies modern radiance through precision and purity
desc_en:
sculpted lines trace the body with architectural grace, while delicate embroidery glimmers like sunlight.
The cutouts at the waist reveal both fragility and strength a dialogue between light and form.
desc_ar: خطوط منحوتة وتطريز رقيق يلمع كضوء الشمس، وفتحات عند الخصر تجمع الرقّة والقوة، إشراقة عصرية بنقاء ودقّة.

name: Arctic
card_en: Cascading icy-blue beading, melts seamlessly into a fluid silhouette that ripples like liquid frost
desc_en:
sculpted bust in the lightest shade of blue, adorned with sapphire and turquoise crystal detailing that drapes gracefully along the neckline, creating a fluid interplay of reflection and movement.
The silhouette extends into a refined teal base, tailored with seamless structure to elongate and contour the form
desc_ar: صدر منحوت بأفتح درجات الأزرق، مزيّن بكريستال الياقوت الأزرق والفيروز، ينساب إلى قاعدة بلون التيل كالصقيع السائل.

name: Crimson Ember
card_en: Levorchy’s signature maroon the color of strength, passion, and timeless allure. The gown’s silhouette is sculpted to perfection, with a corset-inspired bodice hand-embroidered in shimmering beads and sequins that trace the anatomy like liquid fire
desc_en:
Levorchy’s signature maroon the color of strength, passion, and timeless allure. The gown’s silhouette is sculpted to perfection, with a corset-inspired bodice hand-embroidered in shimmering beads and sequins that trace the anatomy like liquid fire

The structured cups and delicate straps evoke both delicacy and power, while draped beaded lines along the waist define the natural form
desc_ar: بلون ليفورشي العنابي المميّز، لون القوة والشغف. صدّ مستوحى من الكورسيه، مطرّز يدوياً بالخرز والترتر كالنار السائلة.

name: Crimson Dawn
card_en: Captures the first breath of morning through a cascade of glimmering fringes in silver, rose, and deep red
desc_en:
transitions from shimmering silver to soft nude and deep crimson in cascading layers of crystal fringe. Each strand moves like rays of early sunlight breaking through the horizon, blending fluid motion with architectural precision.

The hand-embroidered bodice glistens with silver light, seamlessly flowing into an ombré of fiery reds that capture the rebirth of dawn  a signature Levorchy harmony between sparkle, structure, and storytelling.
desc_ar: شراشيب كريستالية تتدرّج من الفضي إلى النيود فالقرمزي العميق، تتحرّك كأشعة الشمس الأولى عند الأفق.

name: Frozen Aurora
card_en: Ethereal glow of northern skies, hand-embellished with silver crystals that melt into layers of turquoise tulle,
desc_en:
ethereal stillness of turquoise light suspended between night and dawn. The strapless gown unfolds in a cascade of crystal embroidery that melts into layers of translucent tulle, reflecting the cool luminosity of the aurora’s frozen glow.
Each movement shimmers like light dancing on ice — serene, hypnotic, and untamed. Frozen Aurora embodies Levorchy’s vision of celestial elegance: where couture transcends fabric and becomes pure, living light
desc_ar: تطريز كريستالي فضي يذوب في طبقات من التول الفيروزي الشفاف، يتلألأ كضوء يرقص على الجليد.

name: Blush Horizon
card_en: Grace meets awakening light, and femininity takes form in motion
desc_en:
Shimmers in dusty pink tones, intricately embroidered with crystals that trace the body’s curves like morning light.

A halo of feather detailing adorns the neckline, blending texture and delicacy, while cross straps frame the shoulders with architectural balance. Elegant and weightless, Blush Horizon captures the moment where the sky blushes before dawn a whisper of romance within Levorchy’s luminous couture world
desc_ar: بدرجات الوردي الترابي، مطرّز بالكريستال الذي يرسم القوام كضوء الصباح، مع هالة من الريش حول العنق.

name: Lunar Veil
card_en: serenity of moonlit skies. Hand-beaded bodice glimmers like constellations
desc_en:
Lunar Veil gown captures the quiet strength and understated sensuality at the heart of the Aurora Bordeaux collection. With its sculpted bodice hand-embroidered in a lattice of delicate beading, the design shimmers like moonlight reflected on still water.
The asymmetrical layering of sheer, fluid fabric drapes effortlessly along the silhouette, creating a rhythm of movement with every step. Subtle yet powerful, the gown embodies a refined modernity one that celebrates grace through precision and simplicity.

A reflection of Norjan Al Kharouf’s mastery, Lunar Veil evokes the serene allure of nightfall, where femininity meets celestial poise.
desc_ar: صدّ منحوت مطرّز يدوياً بشبكة من الخرز الرقيق، يلمع كضوء القمر على الماء الساكن، مع طبقات شفافة غير متماثلة تتحرّك مع كل خطوة.

name: Celestial Dusk
card_en: The Hero of Aurora Bordeaux sculpted in cascading ivory folds, fading into LEVORCHY’s signature maroon
desc_en:
The Hero Gown of Aurora Bordeaux
The Celestial Dusk gown stands as the radiant centerpiece of the Aurora Bordeaux collection  a masterful expression of sensuality and sophistication. Designed by Norjan Al Kharouf, the piece embodies the collection’s core philosophy: the meeting of light and shadow, grace and strength.
Draped in luminous champagne silk with rich Bordeaux undertones, the gown’s fluid ruching delicately contours the body, evoking the movement of twilight waves against the horizon. A deep halter neckline and a daring front slit reveal both confidence and allure, while the cascading train captures the drama of the setting sun fading into night.
Celestial Dusk is not merely a dress it is a statement of power, poise, and timeless femininity
desc_ar: فستان البطولة في مجموعة أورورا بوردو: حرير شمباني مضيء بلمسات بوردو، بكشكشة منسابة ورقبة رسن عميقة وذيل متدفّق كغروب الشمس.

name: Radiant Rebirth
card_en: Sparkle mirrors the rebirth of light after darkness
desc_en:
The gown’s architecture begins with an asymmetric neckline, where one shoulder is delicately draped while the other reveals a crystallized strap, symbolizing balance between fluidity and structure

At the core, a mirrored panel stretches through the torso, hand-embellished with thousands of reflective crystals and metallic fragments. These mirrored details catch every glint of light, creating a living aurora effect that shifts with movement as if the gown itself is awakening

The fitted bodice transitions into flowing silk panels that part gently at the legs, sculpting both motion and grace. The draped sleeve that falls from one arm adds a touch of drama, echoing the elegance of classical couture with a modern Levorchy edge

“Radiant Rebirth” embodies the journey of light rediscovered a vision of renewal, self-realization, and the eternal power of feminine radiance
desc_ar: رقبة غير متماثلة ولوحة مرآتية مطرّزة يدوياً بآلاف الكريستالات اللامعة، تنساب إلى ألواح حريرية، رمز لولادة الضوء من جديد.

name: Bleu Souveraine
card_en:
Three-piece set in imperial blue: embroidered strap bodice, fluid wide-leg trousers, and embellished abaya.
Structured. Precise. Effortlessly sovereign.
desc_en:
A study in precision and presence.
Bleu Souveraine is a three-piece composition defined by structure and fluidity. The strap bodice is sculpted with geometric gold embroidery, tracing the silhouette with deliberate refinement. It reveals strength through symmetry, restraint through detail.
The wide-leg trousers fall with effortless movement, elongating the frame in pure, uninterrupted lines. Layered above, the abaya introduces softness its fluid drape contrasted by fine gold accents that echo the architectural motif beneath.
Each element stands independently. Together, they form a silhouette of quiet command.
Imperial blue, reimagined with modern discipline.
desc_ar: طقم من ثلاث قطع بالأزرق الإمبراطوري: صدّ بأشرطة مطرّز بزخارف ذهبية هندسية، بنطال واسع منساب، وعباءة بلمسات ذهبية.

name: Rouge Jardin
card_en:
Three-piece champagne set featuring a fully hand-embellished strapless top, fluid wide-leg trousers, and braided-sleeve abaya.
Floral couture. Light in motion.
desc_en:
A garden rendered in couture

Rouge Jardin is a three-piece composition sculpted in soft champagne silk, illuminated by hand-placed red and green stones forming dimensional floral motifs. Each embellishment is meticulously set, creating a jeweled surface that captures light with every movement.

The strapless bodice is richly adorned, structured yet delicate in expression. Wide-leg trousers extend the silhouette with fluid precision. Draped above, the abaya introduces quiet drama, its braided sleeves adding artisanal depth and architectural refinement.

It is romance disciplined by structure. Ornament balanced by restraint.
An evening silhouette that feels both timeless and rare.
desc_ar: طقم من ثلاث قطع بحرير الشمباني: صدّ بلا أكتاف مطرّز يدوياً بأحجار حمراء وخضراء على شكل زهور، بنطال واسع، وعباءة بأكمام مجدولة.

name: Éclat de Grenade
card_en: Three-piece set featuring a sculpted strapless top with hand-beaded red florals, tailored brown trousers, and a cape with velvet floral patch detailing
desc_en:
Éclat de Grenade is a three-piece composition where softness meets precision. The strapless bodice is cut with a subtle wave at the hem, breaking symmetry with intention. Hand-beaded red florals bloom across the nude surface, each stone meticulously placed to create depth, light, and movement.
The brown tailored trousers ground the look with quiet strength, allowing the embellishment to speak without excess.
From behind, the cape reveals its secret a velvet patch framed by delicate florals, introducing texture and intimacy to the structure. 

It is detail discovered, not declared.
Romantic, yet disciplined.
Decorative, yet controlled.
A modern couture silhouette with a hidden narrative.
desc_ar: طقم من ثلاث قطع: صدّ بلا أكتاف بزهور حمراء مطرّزة يدوياً، بنطال بنّي مفصّل، وكاب تكشف من الخلف رقعة مخملية مزيّنة بالزهور.

name: Nuit Impériale
card_en:
Three-piece set featuring a fully hand-embellished strapless bodice, fluid wide-leg trousers, and velvet-patch cover with beaded detailing.

Deep. Textural. Effortlessly commanding.
desc_en:
An evening defined by depth.

Nuit Impériale unfolds in layers of midnight blue. The strapless bodice is entirely hand-embellished with fine stones, creating a surface that shimmers like a constellation against the night. Sculpted and precise, it frames the silhouette with quiet intensity.

Wide-leg trousers extend the line with fluid control, balancing structure with softness.

Draped above, the cover introduces contrast through velvet patchwork  a rich oval panel bordered with delicate beading, falling into vertical lines that elongate and refine the movement. The interplay of matte and light, texture and glow, creates dimension without excess.

It is eveningwear reduced to essence.
desc_ar: طقم من ثلاث قطع بالأزرق الليلي: صدّ مطرّز بالكامل بأحجار ناعمة كالنجوم، بنطال واسع، وغطاء برقعة مخملية مطرّزة بالخرز.

name: Or Souverain
card_en:
Three-piece set featuring a fully hand-embellished gold strapless top, tailored trousers, and champagne abaya with refined sleeve detailing.
Luminous. Regal. Effortless.
desc_en:
An ode to light

Or Souverain is a three-piece ensemble built around brilliance and restraint. The strapless bodice is entirely hand-embellished with gold stones, forming a luminous surface that captures and reflects light with quiet intensity. Sculpted cleanly across the neckline, it feels both modern and timeless.

The tailored trousers introduce depth in contrast, grounding the radiance with fluid precision.
Layered above, the abaya falls in soft champagne tones, its sleeves finished with refined detailing subtle accents that echo the gold beneath without overpowering it.
desc_ar: طقم من ثلاث قطع: صدّ ذهبي مطرّز يدوياً بالكامل، بنطال مفصّل، وعباءة بلون الشمباني بتفاصيل راقية على الأكمام.

name: Velours Majesté
card_en:
Two-piece set featuring a long brown velvet cover with embellished cuffs and tailored trousers.
Textural. Structured. Effortlessly regal.
desc_en:
A study in depth and discipline.
Velours Majesté is defined by the richness of brown velvet — dense, fluid, and undeniably refined. The elongated cover drapes with quiet strength, its silhouette clean and architectural.
At the cuffs, hand-embellished detailing introduces light against the matte surface, a controlled contrast that elevates the composition without excess.
Paired with tailored trousers, the ensemble speaks through texture rather than ornament. It is confident in restraint.
An expression of modern nobility — grounded, composed, and enduring.
desc_ar: طقم من قطعتين: غطاء طويل من المخمل البنّي بأساور مطرّزة، وبنطال مفصّل. أناقة بالملمس لا بالزينة.

name: Jardin Pastel
card_en: A sculpted strapless gown in powder blue and rose, featuring asymmetric color blocking and dimensional floral embroidery for a romantic couture finish.
desc_en: Jardin Pastel blends contemporary structure with romantic craftsmanship, featuring a sleek strapless silhouette in powder blue and dusty rose, adorned with dimensional floral appliqués and delicate embroidered greenery.
desc_ar: فستان بلا أكتاف بالأزرق البودري والوردي، بتقطيع لوني غير متماثل وتطريز زهور بارز، بلمسة رومانسية راقية.

name: Eslipse florale
card_en: An ethereal powder-blue gown featuring sculptural silver beaded butterflies, flowing off-the-shoulder sleeves, and a graceful floor-length skirt.
desc_en: Eslipse Florale is a luminous couture creation in icy blue, featuring sculptural silver butterflies and intricate hand-beaded detailing. Fluid sleeves and a flowing skirt complete its romantic, striking silhouette.
desc_ar: فستان بالأزرق الجليدي بفراشات فضية منحوتة من الخرز، أكمام منسدلة على الكتفين وتنّورة طويلة رقيقة.

name: Le Jardin secret
card_en: A fresh couture composition in soft mint and blush pink, illuminated by repeating hand-beaded crystal motifs that scatter light across the surface. Delicate draping introduces a romantic contrast, creating a piece that feels playful, refined, and distinctly modern.
desc_en:
A celebration of color, light, and contemporary couture craftsmanship, this mint and blush creation brings together soft femininity with intricate hand-beaded crystal work.

Across the mint foundation, individually constructed crystal motifs appear like tiny jeweled blossoms, each formed through layers of beads, stones, and reflective embellishments. Their placement creates a delicate rhythm across the piece, allowing light to travel from one motif to another and producing subtle flashes of brilliance with every movement.
desc_ar: تكوين بالنعناعي والوردي الفاتح، تضيئه زخارف كريستالية مطرّزة يدوياً كأزهار صغيرة من الجواهر، مع درابيه رومانسي.

name: Lumbered d’hiver
card_en: A romantic pale-blue gown featuring a deep ruby beaded butterfly wrapped dramatically across the waist. Sculpted ruching, delicate arm embellishments, and airy flowing layers create an elegant contrast between structure and softness.
desc_en: Lumbered d’hiver blends red and blue tones with delicate butterfly motifs and hand-placed crystals, creating a refined and contemporary couture silhouette.
desc_ar: فستان بالأزرق الفاتح تلتفّ حول خصره فراشة ياقوتية مطرّزة بالخرز، بكشكشة منحوتة وطبقات خفيفة منسابة.

name: Jardin Imperial
card_en: Jardin Imperial is a unique couture bridal gown, where hand-beading and crystal embroidery come alive with light and movement.
desc_en: Jardin Imperial is a distinctive couture bridal creation for the bride seeking something rare, expressive, and entirely her own. Intricate hand-beading, crystal embroidery, and individually placed embellishments create rich depth and dimension.
desc_ar: فستان زفاف من الهوت كوتور للعروس التي تبحث عن تصميم نادر يشبهها وحدها، بتطريز يدوي بالخرز والكريستال ينبض بالضوء والحركة.

name: Lilas enchante
card_en: A delicate couture composition in soft lilac, featuring hand-beaded botanical embroidery, crystals, and dimensional floral details that catch the light with a soft, luminous shimmer.
desc_en: Lilas Enchanté is an ode to delicate florals and fluid movement, combining hand-beaded embroidery, crystal detailing, and sculpted floral motifs in an ethereal composition.
desc_ar: تكوين رقيق باللون الليلكي، بتطريز نباتي يدوي بالخرز وكريستال وزهور بارزة تلتقط الضوء بلمعان ناعم.

name: Orchidée de soie
card_en: A refined couture statement in luminous lavender, featuring sculptural crystal embroidery and fluid draping, with jewel-like motifs that shimmer with every movement.
desc_en: Orchidée de Soie is a study in light and couture craftsmanship, featuring sculptural crystal, bead, and stone embroidery that creates a luminous, jewel-like texture against a delicate lavender palette.
desc_ar: قطعة راقية باللافندر المضيء، بتطريز كريستالي منحوت ودرابيه منساب وزخارف كالجواهر تلمع مع كل حركة.

name: Floraison de lavande
card_en: A romantic couture creation in soft lavender, blending sculptural butterflies, delicate florals, and hand-beaded crystals into a dreamlike, luminous composition.
desc_en: Floraison de Lavande is a poetic lavender couture gown inspired by butterflies and twilight gardens, featuring fluid fabric and intricate crystal embroidery. An oversized violet butterfly forms its striking focal point.
desc_ar: فستان باللافندر الناعم مستوحى من الفراشات وحدائق الغسق، بتطريز كريستالي دقيق وفراشة بنفسجية كبيرة في قلب التصميم.

name: Velours écarlate
card_en: A nocturnal couture fantasy in deep amethyst and burgundy, where sculptural petals bloom from the silhouette under a constellation of crystals and meticulous hand-beaded work.
desc_en: Velours Écarlate is a dramatic couture creation inspired by a flower unfolding after dark, blending deep burgundy and amethyst tones with sculptural petals and shimmering crystal details.
desc_ar: خيال ليلي بالجمشتي والعنابي العميق، تتفتّح منه بتلات منحوتة تحت سماء من الكريستال والتطريز اليدوي.

name: Rosé d' amour
card_en: A refined couture statement in soft sage and vivid rose, elevated by hand-beaded crystal details and delicate jeweled accents. Fluid draping and suspended embellishments create graceful movement, allowing the piece to shimmer subtly with every change of light.
desc_en:
A study in contrast, movement, and refined couture craftsmanship, this creation pairs a muted sage base with a vivid rose accent for a look that feels both elegant and unexpected.

The embellishment is intentionally concentrated, with hand applied crystals, beads, and jewel like motifs adding points of light across the piece. Delicate suspended details create subtle movement along the upper section, while scattered crystal accents continue through the rose draping, giving the design a sense of continuity from top to hem.

Soft folds and asymmetric draping shape the composition with effortless fluidity, while the long contrasting panels introduce a dramatic sense of movement as they trail behind the wearer. As the fabric shifts, the crystals catch the light in small flashes, revealing different textures and reflections from every angle.
desc_ar: قطعة بالأخضر المريمي والوردي الزاهي، بتفاصيل كريستالية مطرّزة يدوياً وزينة معلّقة تتحرّك بخفّة مع كل ضوء.

name: La reina
card_en: A dramatic couture composition in deep fuchsia and soft blush, combining fluid satin draping with an intricately worked ornamental panel. Rich embroidery, delicate beadwork, and jewel-like accents bring depth and luminosity to the design, creating a refined balance between softness, movement, and statement craftsmanship.
desc_en:
A celebration of contrast and couture detail, this gown pairs luminous fuchsia draping with a delicately patterned blush panel, creating a composition that feels both regal and contemporary.

The central panel is enriched with ornamental embroidery, intricate beadwork, and crystal-like accents, forming a continuous decorative motif inspired by classical textile artistry. The detailing extends through the upper section, allowing the pattern to become part of the structure of the gown rather than simply an embellishment.

Around it, fluid fuchsia satin wraps and falls in generous folds, creating movement and a sense of effortless drama. The contrast between the richly detailed center and the smooth surrounding fabric allows each element to stand out, while the sheen of the satin responds beautifully to changing light.
desc_ar: تكوين درامي بالفوشيا والوردي الفاتح، يجمع درابيه الساتان المنساب مع لوحة مزخرفة بتطريز غني وخرز ولمسات كالجواهر.

name: Fleurs de rubis
card_en: A vivid couture statement in saturated fuchsia, adorned with sculptural hand-formed flowers and delicate pastel botanical details. The floral appliqués appear to grow organically across the gown, creating dimension, movement, and a striking contrast between bold color and soft craftsmanship.
desc_en:
A celebration of color and contemporary floral craftsmanship, this fuchsia couture creation transforms delicate blossoms into sculptural elements that seem to bloom directly across the fabric.

Clusters of hand crafted three dimensional flowers in soft blush, lilac, and muted mint are individually arranged along the gown, creating an organic composition that travels from the shoulder through the waist and down the flowing panel. Each flower is shaped with dimensional petals and subtle jeweled centers, adding depth and intricate detail against the vibrant background.
desc_ar: قطعة بالفوشيا الزاهي، مزيّنة بزهور منحوتة يدوياً بألوان الوردي والليلكي والنعناعي، تبدو وكأنها تنمو على الفستان.

name: Pivoine Céleste
card_en: A dramatic couture creation in deep rose and soft blush, combining dense hand beaded crystal work with sculptural layers of sheer organza. The richly embellished surface catches the light from every angle, while the voluminous ruffles bring softness, movement, and a sense of modern romance.
desc_en:
A bold expression of texture, light, and couture craftsmanship, this rose toned creation contrasts a clean sculpted upper section with an intensely embellished body and cascading layers of soft organza.

The central section is covered in meticulous hand beading, crystals, sequins, and tonal embroidery, creating a richly textured surface that shifts between blush, garnet, and deep rose as the light moves across it. Striped bands of darker embellishment add rhythm and depth, while intricate motifs appear almost suspended within the sparkling composition.
